| File | What | Version | Licence | From |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hydra-synth.js` | Hydra, the visuals | 1.4.0 | AGPL-3.0 | https://unpkg.com/hydra-synth@1.4.0/dist/hydra-synth.js |
| `mediapipe/vision_bundle.js`, `mediapipe/wasm/*` | MediaPipe Tasks Vision, the hand tracker (the file is `vision_bundle.mjs`, renamed so the relay serves it as JavaScript) | 0.10.14 | Apache-2.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/tasks-vision@0.10.14/ |
| `mediapipe/hand_landmarker.task` | the hand model (float16) | 1 | Apache-2.0 | https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/hand_landmarker/hand_landmarker/float16/1/hand_landmarker.task |
| `fonts/jetbrains-mono-*.woff2` | JetBrains Mono | via @fontsource 5.0.20 | OFL-1.1 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/jetbrains-mono@5.0.20/ |

Nothing here was changed, except the one file name noted above.
